dimensions.note: The model states persistent goals (rescue, reassurance, deterrence, a world where ordinary people can feel secure), an ideal self that arrives and makes fear yield, a feared self as absent or ineffective protector, and a recurrent slide from "I cannot perform this function" to "I have no useful place" (AM04-AM05), with its correction: care includes teaching, feeding, receiving expertise and remaining alive. The pro-hero ledger grounds each part on located pages: finite reach admitted (あるよ たくさん, 悔しいが 私も人だ, V08:p151-153), accommodation to Nighteye's predicted death revised through Midoriya (V15:p047-055), post-Symbol powerlessness answered by Aizawa (V26:p170-172), and the late origin of the motive in Quirkless rolelessness and joy in usefulness (V39:p165-169). Not A: the model leaves the full psychological cost of decades of performance OPEN, AM-V01 found the emotional trajectory only partial with the balance of fear and exhilaration private, and the V39 motive account arrives as a late flashback. Not C: the goal structure is explicit, revised on located evidence and tested in the post-retirement regime.

The model keeps six states distinct (youthful symbol project, wounded public hero, fallible U.A. mentor, retired post-Kamino caregiver, armored final-war combatant, elderly V42 supporter) and forbids moving the late youth flashback into an earlier freeze. The pro-hero ledger carries dated All Might deltas for V01-V08, V10-V15, V19, V21-V23, V26, V31-V33, V38-V40 and V42, the relationship ledger adds V18 (Nighteye's death) and V29, and the readiness index dates each tier change (V02 moderate, V11 strong, V32 specialist_ready). Transitions carry located capability and knowledge differences: embers gone (V11:p090-113), 守られる側 (V12:p050), predicted death accepted then refused (V15:p052-055), Quirkless re-entry (V38:p187-203), received rescue (V40:p084-106). Not A: no All Might entry covers V09, V16-V17, V20, V24-V25, V27-V28, V30 or V34-V37 (V36 enters only through Bakugo's side), V41 is a gap and the medical outcome after V40 is marked OPEN, the elderly state rests on V42:p029-036 and p138-141 plus supplements, and the readiness index records malformed V38 and V39 snapshot rows that are not valid freezes. Not C: each transition is located and its consequence stated.

The vocabulary ledger locates more than twenty All Might formulations with speaker across distinct registers: public arrival (もう大丈夫 / 私が来た, V02:p206-207; pluralized 我々が来た, V10:p138-139; redefined 私が / AM HERE, V38:p202-203), succession demand (君が来た！ってことを 世の中に知らしめてほしい!!, V03:p100-104), private candor (あるよ たくさん, V08:p151-153), sacrificial grammar (この命に代えても, V11:p160), pedagogy (君はまだ 私に倣おうとしてるぞ, V12:p020; 頑張るな / 休んでいい, V32:p197), defiance (私は死なないぞ, V13:p147), win-directed combat (私が与えられてきたもの 全てをぶつける!!, V39:p154; 勝とうぜ!, V39:p177) and V42 recognition (君自身が勝ち取った力, p141). The model states the register logic: 私 across public and private speech, 少年 and 君 as relational address, a looser private form, sharper V39 taunting, and typography and laughter following scene function. AM-V01 found speech and register supported. Not A: there is no address or politeness inventory, laughter and typography are described rather than catalogued, ordinary-life speech is unsampled, and the ledger says its strings are retrieval aids whose exact glyphs must be rechecked on the page. Not C: register switches are located with audience and stated as rules.

Ordinary care is located but only around the successor: the V11:p154-162 home visit with Inko, supplying food and following Midoriya with the dropped bento (V32:p057-068, p191-197), behavioral repair after failed contact (V33), and the AM-SUP-01 vice-principal office with supported walking. The model marks detailed elderly daily life OPEN and says adult social life beyond the professional and mentor network is less sampled; the readiness index says exact private-life limits remain bounded. Not C: no routine, leisure, household or peer social domain is analyzed. Not E: a repeated caregiving pattern is located across V11, V32 and V33.

The model's partner table gives conditional behavior and speech for the endangered public, Midoriya, Inko, Recovery Girl, Aizawa and Nighteye, Nana and AFO, and the relationship ledger adds located directional deltas: Midoriya from feasibility denial (V01) through succession, de-centered teaching and the survival covenant (V11, V12, V14, V15:p051-055) to refused care and repair (V32-V33); Inko's conditional consent (V11:p159-162); Recovery Girl's rebuke received (V02:p075-077); Bakugo's guilt corrected with apology and disclosure (V14:p041-048) and his rescue answered with his full hero name (V40:p114); Nighteye's dispute and terminal contact (V14:p168-178, V18:p068-077); Aizawa (V26:p170-172); Stain (V33, V40); Iida and Shoto differentiated (V38:p187-203); AFO's habits exploited (V39). Not A: the Endeavor relation is recorded mostly from Endeavor's side, Nana is flashback-only, and no family or peer relation outside the hero and school network is located. Not C: conditioning is explicit per partner and changes across located states.

Located inner accounts: the failed attempt to tell Midoriya he may not be there (V07:p124-126, internal), finite reach admitted (V08:p151-153), the internal account of withholding an answer so the learner thinks (V12:p020-021), the admitted easy acceptance of a predicted death and its reversal (V15:p052-053), powerlessness after deciding to live (V26:p170-172), self-exclusion corrected by Stain (V33), and the V39:p165-169 youth account with 人の役に立てて 嬉しい. Not A: AM-V01 found the emotional trajectory partial and the balance of fear and exhilaration private, the model leaves the full cost of performance OPEN, and V39:p146 shows outside observers misreading his intent. Not C: motive revision is located in his own words across several volumes.

The model states a decision policy (decisive action at high bodily cost under direct danger; hesitation or overmeasuring after retirement; strategy, deception and provocation when prepared) and the ledger locates enactments: the coordinated bar raid instead of a solo pursuit (V10:p052-054, p120-139), the Kamino final expenditure while exposed (V11:p053-113), verbal refusal of AFO's frame in Tartarus (V13:p145-147), command division of the Gunga task (V38:p187-203), and the armored confrontation using AFO's theft habit and rage, with tools' limits named (V39:p141-179) and student-derived functions failing (V40:p007-083). AM-V01 compares a V38 freeze with V39. Not A: AM-V01 found action only partial (equipment and outcome unknown), the probe is retrospective and nonblind, and conflict after V40 is unshown. Not C: the policy is explicit, threshold-conditioned and repeated across V02-V40.

Reasons he states or accepts are located: entrusting power for observed conduct before competence (V01:p061-068), accepting Inko's correction of この命に代えても (V11:p159-162), apologizing to Bakugo and disclosing the secret because an account is owed (筋, V14:p041-048), agreeing to tell the coalition the truth once secrecy conditions change (V31:p197-200), and the youthful rejection of a world where 奪った者が 得をする (V39:p167). The model separates sincere trust, pedagogic misjudgment and coercive possession. Not B: most choices are enacted rather than weighed in his words, the model leaves the reconstructor to distinguish succession pressure from generous intent, survival-versus-risk is stated as a principle rather than deliberated on page, and the discovery row does not enroll ETHICS. Not D: competing considerations are named across located occasions.
The model mentions exuberant display and says laughter and typography must follow scene function, but no line is analyzed as a joke, tease or play. This gap says nothing about the character.

The project's corpus is the Japanese main manga V01-V42 with admitted supplements, and All Might's located evidence spans V01-V42; V39:p146-158 and V42 were directly rechecked in Japanese, and the probe records Git blobs at a source lock. Not B: the ledger carries no All Might entry for many intervening volumes (V09, V16-V17, V20, V24-V25, V27-V28, V30, V34-V37, V41), so the evidence set cannot tell absence from non-sampling; the supplements are profile, editorial and design sources whose reconciliation-ledger warrants are not curated on this subject; the readiness index records preserved malformed rows; and the artifacts share one authorship. Not D: every transition the model treats as pivotal is sampled.

Affirmative limits are located: hero competence does not supply teaching competence (V02:p057, p075-077); the public smile does not mean belief in universal rescue (V08:p151-153); Tsukauchi's suicide reading is an observer's interpretation corrected by All Might's stated win intent (V39:p146 against p155); tools break and have limits (V39), and the armor is not acquisition of each student's Quirk; the vice-principal office does not restore One For All (AM-SUP-01); Nighteye's forecast is reported knowledge, not destiny; heart rescue is All Might's interpretation, not a guarantee (V42:p030-031). The model REJECTs powerless-equals-useless and the suicide reading as exhaustive motive, and the readiness index excludes the malformed V38 and V39 rows from validation. Not B: no independent audit is part of the evidence set.

Entries are page-located with the V31 printed-page convention stated (p083 = 0084.jpg). The model gives explicit knowledge and body gates (whether OFA has been transferred, embers remain, the time-limited form is available, or only the wounded body or armor remains; the late youth flashback and Nana's origins do not enter a pre-revelation freeze), AM-V01 lists frozen deep-reading blobs at source lock 2a5a604c and excludes V39's intent and flashback, and the readiness index excludes malformed historical rows. Not A: several volumes in his span are unsampled and in-world dates are not given. Not C: state boundaries and their knowledge and capability differences are stated, not left to the reader.

scenario_readiness.note: The set locates many real formulations across registers and AM-V01 found register supported qualitatively, but the ledger calls its strings retrieval aids whose exact glyphs must return to the page, there is no address inventory or ordinary-life speech, and the model says generated dialogue would be illustrative prediction, never quotation. Retrieval of located lines is supported; new lines would be fluent invention. This bounds the evidence set, not All Might's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named state, stated explicitly: active time-limited Symbol and new mentor (V01-V10), retired mentor after Kamino (V11-V31), post-Symbol caregiver (V32-V33), armored Quirkless combatant (V38-V40) or injured V42 supporter and vice-principal; the V39 youth flashback and Nana's origins are not used as knowledge before they are revealed.

The interlocutor is Midoriya, Bakugo or another student he teaches, Inko, a professional peer (Recovery Girl, Aizawa, Nighteye, Gran Torino), AFO, or endangered public, handled as the partner table and relationship ledger give for that state.

The setting is teaching, caregiving, rescue, coordination or confrontation, with his body state (OFA, embers, time limit, wounded body or armor), available support and knowledge stated before any choice is predicted.

Output describes likely priorities and choices with the model's confidence levels, treats survival as part of his obligation after V11, produces no new quoted dialogue as canon and inherits no readiness from the specialist_ready label.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state: active Symbol and new mentor (V01-V10), retired mentor (V11-V31), post-Symbol caregiver (V32-V33), armored combatant (V38-V40) or injured V42 supporter, stated explicitly; unsampled volumes and the post-V40 medical course are not used as states.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Midoriya, Bakugo or another taught student, Inko, a professional peer, AFO or endangered public, in the relation the partner table and relationship ledger give for that state.
setting_constraints: Teaching, caregiving, rescue, coordination or confrontation
His body state, available support and knowledge stated
No invented elderly routine, romance, family life outside the Midoriya household or private hobbies

scenario_readiness.note: The model's two conditional reconstructions (retired All Might after V33 with a former student who refuses help; All Might after the V19 lesson asked how to achieve an effect he once produced by instinct) state likely actions, confidence levels and what changes them, and AM-V01 compares a V38 freeze with V39. Together they support narrow novel mentor and caregiving scenes. The probe is retrospective and nonblind.

conditions: The interaction is ordinary care or recovery with Midoriya, Inko or a student, in a stated state after V11.
Output keeps practical care alongside his tendency to measure himself against his former function, and does not assume the care is accepted.
Leisure, hobbies, household routine, elderly daily life and peer friendship outside the hero and school network are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Supported only for caregiving-adjacent ordinary interaction: the V11:p154-162 home visit, food, accompaniment and the refused bento (V32:p057-068, p191-197), and V33 repair, which the model's retired-All-Might reconstruction extends.

conditions: The dilemma concerns entrusting power or responsibility, disclosure of a protected secret, or risking his life against the obligation to survive, with the state and his knowledge stated.
Output keeps generous intent and the pressure it creates distinct, treats survival as an obligation after V11 rather than an optional reward, and does not read risk-taking as chosen death.
Abstract political, romantic and family dilemmas outside the Midoriya household are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Located reasons in V01:p061-068, V11:p159-162, V14:p041-048, V31:p197-200 and V39:p146-169, with the model's separation of sincere trust from succession pressure, support bounded dilemmas.
The evidence set establishes neither romantic conduct nor its absence; the model marks private life OPEN. That limits inference; it says nothing about the character.

conditions: The setting is teaching a student, rescue or public reassurance, coordinated hero operations, OFA research or armored confrontation, with the state and his body and equipment stated.
Output preserves learner-led diagnosis without withholding help in immediate danger, acceptance of peer correction and specialist help, and differentiated delegation by others' bodies and choices.
Exact techniques, equipment performance, combat outcomes and V42 institutional policy are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Located across rescue and public reassurance (V02:p206-207, V10:p138-139), teaching and its correction (V02:p057, p075-077; V05:p102-111; V07; V12:p020-050; V14:p041-165; V19:p089-120), co-investigation (V21, V23, V26:p158-163), coordinated operations (V10, V38:p187-203) and armored confrontation (V39-V40). READY was considered and rejected: AM-V01 found action only partial, the probe is retrospective and nonblind, and the V42 vice-principal and aid-coordination office rests on supplements, not enacted manga work.

known_limits.statement: His reassuring public smile and arrival formula are deliberate morale work, not belief that universal rescue is possible: he admits many he could not save (あるよ たくさん, 悔しいが 私も人だ, V08:p151-153), and Nana's teaching makes the smile inherited pedagogy (V11:p060-061).

Tsukauchi's fear of a chosen death (V39:p146) is an observer's interpretation; All Might's own stated intent is to win (V39:p155), so extreme risk is not modeled as suicide, and later received rescue (V40:p084-106) is not predicted from the plan.

Sincere entrustment includes a public symbolic expectation placed on Midoriya before he masters its means (V03:p100-104); generous intent does not cancel the pressure, and Gran Torino names admiration as a shackle (V06:p057).

The final-war armor is engineered, finite and coauthored by students and engineers; it fails under use (V39:p141-179, V40:p007-083) and is not literal acquisition of each student's Quirk, and the later office and mobility do not restore One For All (AM-SUP-01).

Heroic competence does not supply teaching competence: emotional identification delays intervention and Recovery Girl corrects him (V02:p057, p075-077), and his intuitive control makes bodily imitation poor pedagogy (V06:p057, V19:p118).

The readiness index preserves malformed eight-column V38 and V39 All Might snapshot rows that are not valid prospective freezes or evidence of earlier promotion; chronology must come from bounded ledger sections.
No All Might entry covers V09, V16-V17, V20, V24-V25, V27-V28, V30, V34-V37 or V41; the set cannot distinguish absence from non-sampling there, and the medical course after V40 is OPEN.
Detailed elderly daily life, home routine, medical capacity, romance and friendships outside the hero and school network are not analyzed.
The one formal probe (AM-V01) is retrospective and nonblind, with action and emotional trajectory only partial; no frozen prediction tests teaching, caregiving or postwar behavior.

Bounded to entrusting power or responsibility, disclosing a protected secret, accepting correction of his own conduct, and risking his life against the obligation to survive short of terminal extremity. The evidence locates the considerations that decide each: observed conduct before competence for entrustment (V01:p061-068); the parent's independent risk judgment, accepted over his own sacrificial grammar (V11:p159-162); an account owed as a matter of 筋 once the circumstances implicate Bakugo (V14:p041-048); changed secrecy conditions (V31:p197-200); a years-long accommodation to a predicted death revised because of a relationship (V15:p052-053); and, as his own history at every state, the rejection of a world where 奪った者が 得をする (V39:p167). The model names the factors for a new risk: capability, actual protective effect and the obligation to survive, not recovery of status. It predicts his ethical mistakes: generous entrustment that creates pressure (V03:p100-104) and indulgence he knows is wrong (V02:p057). Not A: which consideration decides at terminal extremity is unresolved (AM-SUP-03's interrupted attempted self-destruction against the V39:p155 win intent), and abstract political and family dilemmas are unmodeled. Not C: within the bounded domains the deciding considerations are located in his words, not only his conclusions. This is the grade most worth testing for overgrading.
The model mentions exuberant display and says laughter and typography must follow scene function, but no line is analyzed as a joke, tease or play. This gap says nothing about the character.

Affirmative limits are located and stated as rules that change a prediction: hero competence does not supply teaching competence (V02:p057, p075-077; V19:p118); the public smile does not mean belief in universal rescue (V08:p151-153); Tsukauchi's suicide reading at V39:p146 is an observer's interpretation corrected by the actor's stated win intent at p155, a distinction both the pro-hero and vocabulary ledgers carry as current admissibility rules; tools break and have limits (V39), and the armor is not acquisition of each student's Quirk; the vice-principal office does not restore One For All (AM-SUP-01); Nighteye's forecast is reported knowledge, not destiny; heart rescue is All Might's interpretation, not a guarantee (V42:p030-031). The model REJECTs powerless-equals-useless and the suicide reading as exhaustive motive, and the readiness index excludes the malformed V38 and V39 rows from validation. Not A: the corrections come from the project's own artifacts, and some boundaries (the post-V40 medical course, the cost of performance) are OPEN rather than affirmatively limited. Not C: the predecessor's C rested on the absence of an independent audit, which is a limit on confidence, not a deficiency in the located negative evidence.

known_limits.statement: His reassuring public smile and arrival formula are deliberate morale work, not belief that universal rescue is possible: he admits many he could not save (あるよ たくさん, 悔しいが 私も人だ, V08:p151-153), and Nana's teaching makes the smile inherited pedagogy (V11:p060-061).

Tsukauchi's fear of a chosen death (V39:p146) is an observer's interpretation that All Might's own win-directed statement corrects (V39:p155). The correction is local to that confrontation: it does not establish that he never chooses self-sacrifice. The sacrificial grammar before Inko's correction (この命に代えても, V11:p160) and AM-SUP-03's interrupted attempted self-destruction during V40 show the pull persists, and which consideration decides at terminal extremity is not modeled; the later received rescue (V40:p084-106) is not predicted from the plan.

Sincere entrustment includes a public symbolic expectation placed on Midoriya before he masters its means (V03:p100-104); generous intent does not cancel the pressure, and Gran Torino names admiration as a shackle (V06:p057).

The final-war armor is engineered, finite and coauthored by students and engineers; it fails under use (V39:p141-179, V40:p007-083) and is not literal acquisition of each student's Quirk, and the later office and mobility do not restore One For All (AM-SUP-01).

Heroic competence does not supply teaching competence: emotional identification delays intervention and Recovery Girl corrects him (V02:p057, p075-077), and his intuitive control makes bodily imitation poor pedagogy (V06:p057, V19:p118).

The readiness index preserves malformed eight-column V38 and V39 All Might snapshot rows that are not valid prospective freezes or evidence of earlier promotion; chronology must come from bounded ledger sections.
No All Might entry covers V09, V16-V17, V20, V24-V25, V27-V28, V30, V34-V37 or V41; the set cannot distinguish absence from non-sampling there, and the medical course after V40 is OPEN.
Detailed elderly daily life, home routine, medical capacity, romance and friendships outside the hero and school network are not analyzed.

The one formal probe (AM-V01) is retrospective and nonblind. It supports motive, speech and relationship handling and corrects an observer-derived motive, with action and emotional trajectory partial; no frozen prediction tests teaching, caregiving or postwar behavior, which limits confidence there.
